shared_elements: patterned/pleated garment rendered with parallel incised lines
raised arm/hand gesture toward another figure
justification: Both show bearded male figures in relief with headgear, profile heads, and garments rendered as fine parallel incised lines, and in both a figure extends an arm toward an adjacent figure. But A is a processional file of upright standing robed dignitaries in a horizontal register, whereas B is a compact circular composition centred on a frontal, winged, seated/kneeling hero flanked and enclosed by curving wings, a scheme with no counterpart in A.
